g.text: maximum wire distance (tested in my experiment)
is 120 cm, to ensure analog output signal of
each soil sensor can be transmitted to op-amp
without being distorted by EMI / noise .
Reference designators below are soldered in my
- for internal charge pump : C3, C4, C5, C6
Be aware of unexpected power-up behavior, that is,
OLED board may start operating with floating power
pins, possible cause is leakage path between data
pins and external capacitors wired to internal charge
pump, and that pump has been enabled during
